WAVE_1.theme: Operational Product Intelligence (classified factory snapshot + MP exclusivity + shipping)

WAVE_3.reason: Canonical routes exist; owner/AuthZ still TO_INVENTORY for several Supplies/Production handlers; projection and volume bounds required.

WAVE_4.reason: Aggregated business questions are evident from route semantics; privacy/attachment exclusions remain.

WAVE_5.reason: Financial READ is not forbidden; start from aggregates. HR remains privacy-blocked.
